CheckTitle: IAM user has at most one active permanent access key
Description: **Huawei Cloud IAM** users should have at most **one active permanent access key** at a time, except briefly during planned credential rotation.
Risk: Having multiple active permanent access keys per user expands the credential attack surface and makes key inventory, auditing, and emergency revocation harder.

Code.Other:
1. Log on to the **Huawei Cloud console**.
2. Navigate to **Identity and Access Management (IAM)** > **Users**.
3. Select the user and open **Security Settings** > **Access Keys**.
4. Disable or delete redundant active access keys so at most one remains active.

Recommendation.Text: Keep at most **one active access key** per IAM user and delete superseded keys immediately after rotation.
